name: Kanmuri Ranma
source:
Part of unit Eme☆Kare

His trademark is his hat of his favorite mascot character.
He is an otaku who enrolled into the academy to be able to act alongside a voice actor he respects. Uses plenty of internet slang in his speech. A kind junior who anyone can open their hearts to.
